name: PT Samator Indo Gas Tbk
summary: PT Samator Indo Gas Tbk produces, markets, and distributes industrial gases in Indonesia. The company operates in Gas Product and Equipment and Service segments. It provides air gases, including oxygen, nitrogen, and argon; medical gases, such as oxygen, nitrogen, nitrous oxide, and other medical gases; mixed and specialty gases comprising pure gas, and mixed and calibration gas; hydrocarbon gases, such as natural gas, petroleum, propane, and acetylene; electronic gas; synthetic gases consisting of hydrogen, carbon monoxide, and sulfur dioxide; helium gas and liquid helium; and other gases, including krypton, neon, xenon, ammonia, and fuel gas.
